description: See where your warehouse needs attention Unclocked 3D Heatmap brings warehouse data into an interactive 3D heatmap and 2D floor plan in Power BI. Color locations by your own measures to spot picking hot spots, capacity pressure, aging stock and exceptions. Inspect rack levels and see how activity changes over time. Key capabilities • 3D and 2D exploration: Orbit, zoom and pan, or explore a top-down plan. Use Cutaway to expose lower rack levels or Only this level to isolate one. • Playback and Compare (Professional): Add a Time field to replay activity by period. Compare with the previous, first or a chosen period to see increases and decreases. • Congestion floor (Professional): Shade nearby floor areas using location activity and available pick-face information. This is an activity-based indicator, not a measurement of people, delays or travel routes. • Exceptions and thresholds: Find high or low values, zeros, blanks or a DAX exception score. Set color thresholds manually or drive them with measures. • Selection and report interaction: Search for a location or select an area to inspect details and summary values. Use selections to filter or highlight other visuals, and follow report slicers. • Views that fit your workflow: Dim or hide categories, align a floor-plan image and return to named Saved views.
